sections.heading: Turn data into decisions, governed from day one
sections.body:
From AI strategy to agentic AI in production: turn data into decisions, governed from day one. We connect roadmaps, use cases and value with the data platforms, pipelines and analytics that make AI useful.

Bring autonomous agents and knowledge assistants into enterprise work, with guardrails, cost and observability considered from the start. Our own software IP complements specialist services across document intelligence, financial analytics and education workflows.

sections.heading: Specialist services and LINKFIELDS IP
sections.body: Explore our services and the Linkfields products that bring reusable software IP into enterprise delivery.

cards.title: AI strategy & governance
cards.description: AI strategy: Roadmaps, use cases & value. AI governance: Guardrails, cost & observability. Set a practical direction for AI and define how it will be overseen.

cards.title: Agentic AI & GenAI
cards.description: Agentic AI: Autonomous agents that act. GenAI & RAG: Knowledge assistants on your data. Connect enterprise knowledge with the work your teams need to complete.

cards.title: Data platforms & analytics
cards.description: Data & analytics: Platforms, pipelines & Power BI. Build on Big Data Engineering to collect, organise and analyse information. Accelerators: Predictive Analytics Suite · Digital Twin Suite.

cards.title: Machine learning
cards.description: Prediction, scoring & forecasting. Churn and segmentation, demand forecasting, fraud and risk scoring, anomaly detection and predictive maintenance, evaluated and governed from day one.

cards.title: textIQ
cards.description: **LINKFIELDS IP** — Intelligent search and insight across unstructured enterprise content. Document intelligence: extraction, classification and summarisation over unstructured documents, turning filed paperwork into fields a system can query.

cards.title: FinSight
cards.description: **LINKFIELDS IP** — Conversational analysis and reporting over financial data. Financial insight and reporting analytics over banking data, built for the people who have to explain the number as well as produce it.

cards.title: EduPilot
cards.description: **LINKFIELDS IP** — Rapid course creation for education and corporate learning. An AI assistant for education workflows and learner support, grounded in an institution's own material.
